item.title: How Alexandria preserves Black history
item.description: Two hundred years ago, Alexandria, Virginia, was a hotbed for human trafficking. In fact, one of America’s largest slave trading companies operated on Duke Street, seizing and selling people from 1828 until 1861. item.description: Q: For those of us women who would prefer to meet people in real life, where do men of a certain age go? item.description: Terry Landers’ pickleball injuries include two concussions, a broken wrist, a shoulder injury, a torn thumb and a black eye. None of those disasters kept her from the court.
